description: Test suite for the httpservice package, focusing on HTTP client behavior, proxy handling, IP filtering, and user-agent setting.

methods.name: TestHTTPClient
methods.description: Tests HTTP client behavior with insecure connections and IP/host filtering.

methods.name: TestHTTPClientWithProxy
methods.description: Tests HTTP client behavior with proxy configuration and IPv6 URL handling.

methods.name: TestDialContextFilter
methods.description: Validates dial context filtering based on IP and hostname restrictions.

methods.name: TestUserAgentIsSet
methods.description: Checks that the user-agent header is correctly set in requests.

methods.name: TestIsReservedIP
methods.description: Verifies detection of reserved IP addresses.

methods.name: TestIsOwnIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is recognized as the local machine's IP.

methods.name: TestSplitHostnames
methods.description: Tests splitting of hostnames from configuration strings.

methods.name: TestGetProxyFn
methods.description: Validates proxy URL selection based on environment variables and URL parsing.

methods.name: NewHTTPClient
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP client with specified transport.
